description: A zone that one of ipv6ddns's resolvers answers from memory, for the clients on its network: see the [resolver](../resolver.md). Its debounce defaults to none, since nothing is sent anywhere.

resolver.description: Which of the resolvers answers the zone. Needed only when there's more than one.

zone.description: The zone: a subdomain of a domain you own, such as lan.example.com, or home.arpa.

records.description: Records of names in the zone that no task publishes, one per entry, in zone file syntax, relative to the zone or absolute within it: printer A 192.168.1.20, files CNAME nas, _ipp._tcp SRV 0 0 631 printer. A record without a TTL gets the zone's.

ttl.description: The TTL of the names' addresses, and of the records that give none, as 5m or 1h. Default: 1m. An address that expires sooner is answered with the time it has left.
